stories.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI reaches $3.79 billion in estimated first-day sales
stories.summary: Take-Two and Rockstar say Grand Theft Auto VI generated an estimated $3.79 billion in worldwide retail sales during its November 19 launch day, based on the company's estimates. Take-Two also reports 32.5 million units sold before release. The game launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S; no PC release date has been announced.

stories.headline: Nvidia GeForce driver 621.24 linked to excessive SSD writes
stories.summary: PC Gamer reports that Nvidia's GeForce driver 621.24 is associated with repeated SSD writes by NVDisplay.Container.exe, sometimes reaching tens of gigabytes per hour. Affected users can inspect the process's I/O Write Bytes in Windows Task Manager. The earlier 621.01 driver has been reported as a workaround while the cause is investigated.

stories.headline: Winter Burrow reveals Below the Ice fishing DLC for December 9
stories.summary: Pine Creek Games has announced Below the Ice, a paid Winter Burrow DLC releasing December 9. The expansion adds a frozen wetlands biome, ice fishing, three fishing-rod upgrades, a new character and questline, meals, and decorative items. A free accompanying update adds a sixth toolbelt slot and bug fixes for all players.

stories.headline: Capcom games feature in Fanatical's new Black Friday PC bundle
stories.summary: Fanatical has launched a build-your-own Capcom collection with 27 Steam products, including multi-game compilations. VGC reports that customers can choose at least two items, with prices per selection decreasing as the bundle grows. As reported November 20, the eight-item tier costs $6.20 or £6.20 per selection; regional prices may differ.

stories.headline: Fake Grand Theft Auto VI PC port is being used as malware bait
stories.summary: NordVPN's threat intelligence team warns that a fake Grand Theft Auto VI PC port is being used to lure players into downloading malicious software. A toolkit reportedly advertised for sale includes account-stealing malware, a cryptominer and a crypto-wallet drainer. Rockstar has not announced a PC version, so claims of a working PC download should be treated as scams.

stories.headline: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000 showcases fleets and Space Marine campaign systems
stories.summary: Creative Assembly's 80-minute Alpha Strike livestream shows an Ultramarines campaign across the Praevoss system. Fleets transport armies between planets, provide orbital bombardments and deliver reinforcements via drop pods, while losses of Space Marines are deliberately difficult to replace. Each star system functions as its own campaign, with some progress carrying forward. A release date has not been announced.

stories.headline: Minecraft Dungeons II reveals The Humblers Awaken DLC for December 1
stories.summary: Mojang has announced The Humblers Awaken, the first paid Minecraft Dungeons II expansion, for December 1. It adds new quests in the Sift, three active artifacts, four passive talismans and cosmetic rewards. A free update alongside it introduces daily and weekly trial dungeons, more weapons and armor, and returning heroes from the original Minecraft Dungeons as playable skins.

stories.headline: DELTARUNE Chapter 6 reaches playable draft as Chapter 7 work begins
stories.summary: Toby Fox says DELTARUNE Chapter 6 can now be played from beginning to end, with its maps, battles and events in place. Localisation and preliminary testing are starting, although some scenes still need polish before full testing. Work has also begun on Chapter 7. Chapter 6 remains targeted for 2027 and will be a free update for owners of the game.

stories.headline: Persona 6 producer says Atlus aims to shorten future Persona waits
stories.summary: P-Studio general producer Kazuhisa Wada says Atlus is working to reduce the long gaps between numbered Persona games after Persona 6. He cautions that large-scale RPG development can still take five years or more and offers no concrete timetable. Persona 6 itself remains undated, though its PC Steam wishlist page is live.
